hooks.command: $d = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'ClaudeTray'; $verbs = Get-Content (Join-Path $d 'verbs.json') | ConvertFrom-Json; $status = @{ state='thinking'; verb=($verbs | Get-Random); start=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds() } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $d 'status.json') -Value $status -Encoding utf8

$d = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'ClaudeTray'; $status = @{ state='idle'; verb=''; start=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds() } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $d 'status.json') -Value $status -Encoding utf8

$d = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'ClaudeTray'; $status = @{ state='waiting'; verb='Waiting'; start=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds() } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $d 'status.json') -Value $status -Encoding utf8
